items.instruction: Purple and blue label hierarchy is preserved.
No internal slot keys or generator instructions.
No artificial padding or repeated paragraphs.
Appropriate font weight, paragraph spacing, emphasis and visual density.
Where This Brand Creates the Most Value has three differentiated, research-backed scenarios with real hotel imagery.
Key Differentiators has exactly four meaningful bullets in each canonical category (Experience & Identity; Commercial & Distribution).
Value Creation Scenarios preserve full content and card styling.
Operating Model contains every canonical subsection.
Third-Party Operator Compatibility has the full operator fit and capability analysis.
Brand Standards has the proper, substantive multirow table.
Commercial subsections preserve canonical styling and hierarchy.
Demand Scenario View has at least six differentiated, substantive scenarios.
Recent Momentum contains researched hotel openings, signings, conversions or other relevant dated developments.
Geographic Footprint does not reuse brand-wide HPC counts as regional figures.
Brand-level and regional inventory claims have appropriate source attribution and coverage labels.
Loyalty tiers reflect the applicable real program structure.
Loyalty cards preserve the intended layout, hierarchy and explanatory depth.
Gallery images prioritize actual operating hotels.
Official renderings are prioritized for unopened hotels.
Generic logos are used only when no suitable hotel or project imagery exists.
Image failures and inappropriate substitutions block approval.
Similar Brands contains separate competitor cards.
Brand Materials retains actual hotel examples, cases and supporting materials.
Gate 2 content reconstruction blocked until Gate 1 founder approval.
No production Airtable writes, paid research, mass population, or publication without founder auth.
Anti-padding must not clear-without-refill; compose distinct evidence-backed claims.
Factory reconstruction must not use production Presentation as content source (baseline compare-only).
Never mark a lesson VERIFIED without actual browser evidence.
Curio and Ascend remain NOT APPROVED until founder says otherwise.
Reconstruct without reading production Presentation / Curio fixtures as generator input.
Preserve Brand Basics rec… identity; frozen baseline is never overwritten.
Capture founder visual failures as permanent regression baseline (titles-as-paragraphs, imagery, depth, economics, empty lists, hero, comparison misalignment).
Match collection cards by title/signature/source — not solely by array position; Missing/New empty counterparts.
If evidence insufficient: stop generation and record research gap — never min-words via repetition.
Preserve Phase 2H WIP, PR #457, rejected PR #453; no ADP/GDI/HE edits from BE chat.
